g.title: HR_SALARYPROGRAM
g.text: Salary Program - A salary program includes all rules necessary to kick off a salary review process, including eligible people, reviewable items and budget rules.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
With this reference date the user fixes a specific point in time when all initial data, for each participant, will be taken at.
Defines how the hierarchy of salary review pools gets initialized, if, for example, from the org structure or manually imported.
With this set it is possible to identify people that can be potentially affected by the salary review.
Salary program status determines, for example, it’s still in a stage where rules are being defined or whether a salary review process has been already lauched.
The Identifier of the Structure record.
By activating this flag, salary reviewers will also have access, for each participant, to additional items to be reviewed like the Job Class or the Contract Level.
Activating this flag, you enable to assess performance during the salary review.
Flag that indicates if the system should include last compensation history changes.
Compensation number related to show compensation history flag.
Flag that indicates if the system should show compensation history.
Assessment Component related to the Salary Program.
Flag that indicates if the system should include last performance evaluations.
Performance number related to show performance evaluations flag.
The init command's task id of Salary program
This field indicates the date of the last init schedule.
This field indicates the end date of the last init.
This field indicates the status of initializaztion.
The recalculate command's task id of Salary program
This field indicates the date of the last recalculate schedule.
This field indicates the end date of the last recalculate.
The recalculate command's state id of Salary program
Unique identifier of the entity set created by the Init rule of the Salary Program. Contains all program pools.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created

Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_SALARYPROGPOOL
g.text: Salary Program Pool - Identifies a group of people eligible to receive a salary review and the salary reviewer.
The Identifier of the Salary Program record.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
Salary program status determines, for example, it’s still in a stage where rules are being defined or whether a salary review process has been already lauched.
It’s the person in charge of the salary review for all people in the pool.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created

g.title: HR_SALARYPROGCOMPITEMS
g.text: Salary Program Compensation Item - This is the compensation item for the proposed new compensation amount.
The Identifier of the Salary Program record.
The Identifier of the Compensation Item record.
It’s the suggestion matrix that can be used to propose to the reviewer a range of increases for a participant based on two attributes (example his/her performance and his/her grade).
Determines how the salary reviewer will be able to express salary review proposals, if as an absolute amount or an increase percentage.
Identifies how the budget will be calculated, at choice between an absolute amount by participant or a percentage of a base amount that would differ from each participant.
It’s the compensation item which is where the base amount comes from when calculating the budget as a relative base percentage by participant.
It’s the remuneration type which is where the base amount comes from when calculating the budget as a relative base percentage by participant.
It’s the amount per participant that should be considered when calculating the pool budget.
Put here any relevant description to help a reviewer to understand when each suggestion applies.
It’s the percentage that will be used to calculate individual budget starting from an individual base amount.

Using this field you can choose if the base to calculate the individual budget is sourced by another compensation item different from the reviewable compensation item, the same reviewable compensation item or a remuneration type.
